title: Beyond Demographics: Enhancing Cultural Value Survey Simulation with Multi-Stage Personality-Driven Cognitive Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating demographic stereotyping by comparing LLM-simulated survey responses against actual human responses from the World Values Survey across diverse demographic clusters using distribution divergence metrics (1-JSD, EMD) and accuracy.

Measuring the alignment of LLM-simulated value survey responses with actual human preference distributions across different cultural contexts (United States and China) using both English and Chinese prompts.
